 The Bavarian side boast a devastating attack, with 25 goals in seven games, and an 18-match unbeaten league run under Vincent Kompany. Meanwhile, Niko Kovac's Borussia Dortmund arrive in fine form after three consecutive wins and five clean sheets, pinning their hopes on defensive solidity and quick transitions. Another thrilling, goal-filled battle is expected in Munich.
